These are the current and former wave layouts for
mode on standard maps. For differences in

names indicates an enemy type's debut.
Commander, enemies have been detected in this area. Intel reports mention something called "The Fallen." I need you to secure the perimeter and report back what you find.
Dispatcher, these aren't your normal enemies. It' like they're wearing some kind of ancient armor!!
From what little we know, the Fallen are highly organized. Treat them as hostile and keep your distance until we know more.
Look at that rust! I can only imagine how old these guys might be.
Watch out, Commander, those Dregs will leave a corpse behind if their flames go out.
Agh! That Squire has aggro and is pulling our attention! We can't target anything else!
There's a lot of Hidden enemies ahead of you. Make sure none slip by.
Man, I'm shivering! When did it get so cold?
I can tell these guys are getting tougher. Keep your eyes open; we're not out of the woods yet.
The ground is starting to shake! Tell me what's going on!
There's a Fallen Giant up ahead! They're sending in more units too!
This is looking too coordinated for a random attack.
Look up, Commander. There's Fallen Seraphs above you scouting out your position!
Commander, those Jesters aren't throwing normal presents. Each one strengthens the enemies around it!
Take him out before you're overwhelmed!
Get out of the way! They're running right at us!
Maybe we can stop their charge if we break the shields!
Woah… I didn't think the Fallen could use war tactics. They have a Shield in front protecting a Summoner behind it. Just who are these guys?
What… are those? It looks like they're healing themselves.
Fallen Angels. They really make you wonder what else might be out there, huh?
Oh man, what is that thing?! It's even got reinforcements!
According to V's notes, that's the Fallen's most honored. They leave a trail of magic behind them that speeds up any enemy that steps on it!
If that Fallen Guardian is here, that could only mean the King is nearby. Commander, please be careful.
Don't worry. We don't plan on going down that easily.
He'll be calling in reinforcements! Watch yourself out there, Commander!
This is our last stand! Lets give it everything we got!
